title: Corner Conveyor
body:
"ZOOM! (but turning)"


The Corner Conveyor is a structure that can be purchased from The Oak Depot. It is a right angle turn.

Functionality

The Corner Conveyor's switch functions identically to a Straight Conveyor, with a stopped state in the middle of the slider.

Be warned that the protrusions on the side of the Corner Conveyor may occasionally catch an object in them, requiring manual intervention to dislodge the offending object.
